title: Tax set aside
summary: For freelancers and a small business: give a category of money in a tax rate, and every payment in it says what to put aside. See this year's set aside, what you paid the tax office, what your tax account holds against it, and the tax bills still to pay.
changes: Wears its own glyph in the store, a percent, where it shared the piggy bank with Savings circle.
author: BrainDog
